integrity: Proof reconstructed from the stated support-width identity, local parabolic chord asymptotics, analytic no-zero-divisors principle, and a positive-radius smooth counterfamily with vanishing first Fourier modes. A standalone Python verifier provides independent finite and exact-example checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed known perimeter, labelled normal directions, strictly positive curvature, analytic support on both candidate bodies. Does not recover unknown perimeter or assert full smooth-class uniqueness. Truncated directional data only; cannot be equated with the covariogram.
title: Analytic rigidity and smooth ambiguity from directional short-chord tails
